Help and glossary

Local interface boundary

This UI is published only on 127.0.0.1. The current data source is the local API.

Glossary
Assessment
A bounded technical and product review. It is not a legal audit or penetration test.
Safe copy
An immutable source snapshot used so assessment work does not modify the registered repository.
Supporting record
A captured evidence occurrence with its own source, time, validation, sensitivity, and limitations.
Source and confidence
Where a product claim came from and how strongly it is supported. The canonical term is provenance.
File fingerprint
A SHA-256 digest used to detect changes. It does not prove authorship.
Bounded isolation
Layered controls that reduce hostile runtime risk. It is not a guarantee against every escape.
Technical coverage
Checks against a named profile. It does not establish compliance or absence of vulnerabilities.
